Summary: Create the Jira board and backlog
Description: Create the project, import the tickets, define the columns (To Do / In Progress / Review / Done) and the sprints. Make the link accessible to the jury.

Summary: Initialize the public GitHub repository and Git workflow
Description: Public repository. Branches main + develop. One feature/* branch per feature created from develop; merge into develop after testing; merge develop into main after validation. Add .gitignore (node_modules, .env).
Install and configure the front-end (Vite/Vue), back-end, ESLint/Prettier, environment variables (.env.example), local databases (SQL + MongoDB).
List features per role (visitor, user, employee, admin) and justify the technology choices (front-end, back-end, SQL, NoSQL, hosting).
Wireframes of the key pages: home, menu list, menu detail / order. Desktop and mobile versions.
High-fidelity mockups matching the wireframes, with the style guide applied.
Color palette (RGAA-compliant contrast), fonts, logo. PDF export including the mockups.

Summary: Design the data model (MCD / class diagram)
Description: Based on appendix 1: user, role, menu, dish, allergen, theme, diet, order, status history, review, opening hours. Many-to-many menu <-> dish relation.
Actors: visitor, user, employee, administrator.
At least: sign-up, login, placing an order, changing an order status.

Summary: Write the SQL database creation script
Description: .sql file creating the tables (not only migrations/fixtures) with primary/foreign keys and constraints.

Summary: Write the SQL seed data script
Description: .sql insert file: roles, José's admin account, employee, user, menus, dishes, allergens, themes, diets, opening hours, reviews.
Collection storing order statistics per menu, updated on each order (and revenue).

Summary: Set up the back-end API architecture
Description: Project structure (routes, controllers, services, data access), SQL connection using prepared statements, centralized error handling.
Token/session verification and role-based access control (user, employee, admin) on every protected route.

Fields: last name, first name, mobile phone, email, postal address, password. Front + back validation of the password: min 10 characters, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special character. 'user' role assigned automatically. Password hashed (bcrypt/argon2). Welcome email sent.
Login with email + password. Generic error message. Disabled account = login refused. Redirect according to role.
Email form -> sends a link with a unique, expiring token. Page to set the new password (same complexity rules).
Logout button, invalidate the session/token on client and server.
Admin account created only through the SQL script. No route allows creating an administrator account.
Links: Home, Menus, Contact, Login (or My account / Logout when logged in). Responsive (burger menu on mobile).

Summary: Footer with opening hours and legal links
Description: Opening hours Monday to Sunday (loaded from the database), links to Legal notice and Terms of sale.
Company presentation, highlight of the team's professionalism, carousel/list of approved customer reviews only.
Form: title, description, email. Validation. Email sent to the company. Confirmation message.

Summary: Legal notice and Terms of sale pages
Description: Legal notice and terms of sale content (including the 600 EUR fee for unreturned equipment, GDPR policy).
List of menus (public): title, description, minimum number of people, price, 'View details' button.
Filters: max price, price range, theme, diet, minimum number of people. Results update without page reload (API call / fetch).

Shows all info: title, image gallery, description, theme, diet, starters/mains/desserts with allergens, min number of people, price, remaining stock. Menu conditions clearly highlighted (visible box).
Logged-in user -> redirected to the order page with the menu pre-filled. Visitor -> asked to log in or sign up, then redirected back to the order.
Customer info pre-filled (last name, first name, email, mobile phone). Event address, date, time and place. Menu pre-selected when coming from the detail page. Number of people >= menu minimum.
Menu price based on number of people. 10% discount if number of people >= minimum + 5. Delivery: free in Bordeaux, otherwise 5 EUR + 0.59 EUR/km. Recalculated server-side.
Integrate a geocoding/distance API (e.g. OpenRouteService / API Adresse) to compute the km from Bordeaux.
Detailed breakdown: menu price, discount if any, delivery fee, total.

Summary: Save the order and manage stock
Description: Create the order (initial status), decrement menu stock, refuse if out of stock, update MongoDB statistics, send confirmation email.

Summary: List and detail of my orders
Description: The user sees all their orders with full details.
Only allowed while the order is not 'accepted'. Everything editable except the menu. Server-side check.
Once accepted: history of all statuses with date and time of change.
Edit last name, first name, mobile phone, address, email (with validation).

Summary: Leave a review on a completed order
Description: Rating from 1 to 5 + comment, only on a 'completed' order and only once. Review pending moderation.
Create / edit / delete a menu: title, image gallery (upload), description, theme, diet, dishes, min people, price, conditions, stock.
Create / edit / delete starters, mains, desserts with allergens. A dish can belong to several menus.
Edit opening hours Monday to Sunday (displayed in the footer).
Filter by status and by customer.
Statuses: accepted, in preparation, out for delivery, delivered, awaiting equipment return, completed. Each change is logged (date/time).
Must enter the contact method (phone / email) and the reason before any edit or cancellation.
Approve or reject reviews. Only approved reviews appear on the home page.
Form with email + password. Email sent to the employee WITHOUT the password. Creating an admin is impossible.
Make an employee account unusable (login refused) without deleting it.
The admin inherits all employee area features.
Comparison chart (e.g. Chart.js) fed by MongoDB data.
Revenue calculation per menu with filters by menu and by period (start date / end date).
SMTP / transactional service (e.g. Brevo, Mailtrap in dev). HTML templates.
Welcome on sign-up, password reset link, employee account created (without password).
Order confirmation; 'awaiting equipment return' status (10 business days otherwise 600 EUR); 'completed' status (invitation to leave a review).
Forward the contact form request (title, description, email) to the company.
Password hashing, prepared statements (SQL injection), XSS escaping, CSRF protection, CORS, security headers (helmet), rate limiting on login, server-side input validation, HTTPS, secrets in .env.
Cookie banner if needed, consent at sign-up, privacy policy, data minimization, right to delete the account.
Semantic tags, alt attributes, form labels, contrast, keyboard navigation, visible focus, ARIA. Audit (Lighthouse / WAVE) and fixes.
Check every page on mobile, tablet and desktop.
